_note: tier decides where a character appears. 'free' = playable, shown on the choose-your-character screen. 'premium' = shop characters (empty for now). 'npc' = staff and officers. The three playable characters are Mixamo-rigged .glb files (names end in _mixamo.glb): same body and flat feet, three different faces. Their clothes, hair and jewelry come from clothing/female/wardrobe.json. To move a character, move its file into the matching folder and change its entry here.
